rca of the issue: Headline bug 'create-post crash on igPromptVisible/igPromptResolveRef' RCA: the source file /app/frontend/app/create-post.tsx already declares both at lines 140-141 (useState/useRef). On the first browser test attempt the deployed Metro bundle was still serving the older crash-version, indicating Metro hot-reload had missed the change. Mitigation: restart expo via supervisor — after restart, the rebuilt bundle picked up the declarations and the screen rendered cleanly with no ReferenceError. No code change required from main agent; the fix is correct. Reproduction: (1) login via /api/auth/register + localStorage.setItem('auth_token', token); (2) navigate /create-post; (3) inspect console for 'igPromptVisible is not defined' — should be ABSENT now.
